definitions.explanation: The person who leads or presides over a committee. In school contexts, refers to the class representative or homeroom leader.

examples.japanese: {委員長|いいんちょう}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: I was chosen as the committee chairperson.

examples.japanese: クラスの{委員長|いいんちょう}が{連絡事項|れんらくじこう}を{伝|つた}えた。
examples.english: The class representative conveyed the announcements.

examples.japanese: {選挙管理|せんきょかんり}{委員長|いいんちょう}が{結果|けっか}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The election commission chairperson announced the results.

notes:
## Structure
{委員|いいん} (committee member) + {長|ちょう} (head; chief)

## Common Types
- クラス{委員長|いいんちょう} — class representative
- {実行|じっこう}{委員長|いいんちょう} — executive committee chair
- {選挙管理|せんきょかんり}{委員長|いいんちょう} — election commission chair

## Related Words
- {委員|いいん} — committee member
- {委員会|いいんかい} — committee; commission
- {会長|かいちょう} — president (of an organization)
- {議長|ぎちょう} — chairperson (of a legislative body)
